snippet.description:
Prepare for UPSC Civil Services Examination 2027 with our Weekly Current Affairs Class covering 25th October to 31st October 2026, presented by Siddharth Sir.
This session is specially designed for UPSC CSE aspirants who want to strengthen their understanding of important national and international developments from the examination perspective.

In this class, we cover important news, government policies, international relations, economic developments, environmental issues, science and technology, and other significant events relevant to UPSC Prelims and Mains.

✅ Weekly Current Affairs (25–31 October 2026)
✅ Important National & International News
✅ Government Schemes, Policies & Initiatives
✅ Indian Polity & Governance
✅ International Relations
✅ Indian Economy & Financial Developments
✅ Environment & Ecology
✅ Science & Technology
✅ Important Reports, Rankings & Indices
✅ Important Appointments and Events
✅ UPSC Prelims-Oriented Facts and Concepts

• UPSC Civil Services Examination 2027
• IAS Prelims 2027
• UPSC CSE Mains 2027

Why follow random news when you can prepare current affairs through a structured weekly approach?

Join Siddharth Sir for focused current affairs preparation and improve your analytical understanding for UPSC Prelims and Mains.
Subscribe to Margdarshan IAS for regular UPSC Current Affairs, Prelims Strategy, Mains Preparation and Civil Services Guidance.

Stay Consistent. Revise Smartly. Prepare for Success!
